card.name: Punctuation in Bayesian statistics references
card.fires_on: Commas and dashes in bibliography entries of statistics books and papers, mostly Bayesian regression references, right after an author surname or ISBN and before the next author or title.

modes.label: Comma after author surname
modes.description: The comma that follows a surname in an author list.

modes.label: Dash between reference entries
modes.description: A dash separating an ISBN or publisher from the next listed author.
